reason: I grab a Monster or Red Bull at the petrol station or Tesco on the way, no thinking involved. Pre-ordering a 12-pack for 649 plus 39 delivery to a pickup point is more effort than my energy habit is worth, and at 54 a can it costs more than what I already drink.
objection: Why pay 54 crowns for a can of mate when a Monster is cheaper, sitting right there in the fridge, and coffee or water does the job anyway? Numbered cans don't mean anything to me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at the petrol station or Albert I already stop at, around 40 to 45 CZK, and trying a free can that actually tastes good and kicks like a Monster.
